items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: We played with Eric on his last gig in Berlin

ctx.x: Yeah we knew Eric the year before. We played with Eric on his last gig in Berlin and we actually brought him to the hospital. Yeah it was a sad situation. But that was ’64.
Do you remember hearing that and what you thought of it?
